scripts.typecheck: npm run build:web && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w apps/web && tsx scripts/embed-web.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply health --local -c workers/app/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply health --remote -c workers/app/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy -w workers/app && npm run deploy -w workers/mcp
